      "name": "build",

      "evidence": "CI environment script tweaks in ci/test/ are incidental adjustments following kernel test updates",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "One-line CI environment additions merely support the kernel tests and do not constitute a meaningful build system change."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{cpp,h}, kernel wrapper headers, and tests to change C API callback dispatching",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes hangs in applications consuming libbitcoinkernel when log callbacks trigger re-entrant logging or object destruction. As noted in the description, this deadlock occurs when language runtimes like Python run garbage collection finalizers during callbacks, blocking progress on bindings."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp adapt the example tool to the updated kernel callback signature",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updates to bitcoin-chainstate are mechanical downstream adjustments to kernel API changes rather than tooling enhancements."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/util/btcsignals.h locking primitives",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Switches btcsignals to use StdMutex to eliminate recursive deadlocks when lock-debugging checks attempt to log."
    }
  ],
